title: 'Distinct cash shortfall': Rs 7.4 crore in PNB vault swapped with fake notes in UP
content: Authorities are reeling after discovering that ₹7.4 crore in actual cash was exchanged for phony currency at a Saharanpur PNB vault. An FIR has been filed against involved bank staff and private citizens. In response to this astonishing theft, a Special Investigation Team has been set up for a thorough investigation.

title: Hardik Pandya's comeback plans hit a fresh roadblock
content: Hardik Pandya’s return to international cricket is set to face another setback due to a leg niggle, casting doubts on his participation in the upcoming T20I series against Afghanistan. He remains under observation by the medical team at BCCI CoE.

title: 'A particular issue': Penguin India on impasse over Sonia Gandhi memoir
content: Penguin Random House India has decided to pause the publication of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, citing an editorial disagreement. The publisher clarifies that this choice was not influenced by outside pressure but rather emerged from routine editorial evaluations. During the review process, some proposed changes were accepted while others were not. In the end, an unresolved issue led to the book's non-release in India, which the author's team acknowledged.

title: Canada has important information for international students
content: Starting today, Canada has implemented new financial requirements for international student study permits, raising the amount that applicants must demonstrate to accommodate higher living expenses. For single applicants outside Quebec, the required proof has risen to CAD $23,448, an increase of $553. Families applying will also see more significant financial criteria. These adjustments affect those submitting applications after September 1, 2026.

title: From watching anime to translating shuttlers: Young interpreters' untold story
content: Behind the BWF World Championship interviews were interpreters carrying the weight of accuracy. At the recently concluded tournament in New Delhi, young language experts in Mandarin, Japanese and Korean navigated high-pressure media interactions, preparing with archival footage and AI tools to ensure players' words crossed cultural and linguistic barriers without losing their meaning.

title: Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre Irish castle estate; spokesperson says family is ‘excited’
content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his spouse Priscilla Chan have acquired the majestic Strancally Castle in County Waterford, Ireland. Spanning around 440 acres, the estate boasts a rich history dating back to 1830. The couple intends to use this beautifully restored property as a retreat during their visits, reinforcing Meta's strong ties to Ireland, where the company has its international headquarters.

title: Top stocks to buy or sell: Stock market recommendations for today - check list
content: Stock market recommendations: Indusind Bank, Computer Age Management Services (CAMS), and Dixon Technologies (India) are the top stocks to buy that have been picked by Somil Mehta, Head of Retail Research, Mirae Asset ShareKhan for September 1, 2026.

title: 25-yr-old Indian-origin founder's AI startup Cursor acquired by SpaceX in $60B deal
content: Aman Sanger co-founded Anysphere, known for its innovative Cursor application. SpaceX's recent acquisition of Anysphere for $60 billion propels its founders into billionaire status. Cursor revolutionizes developer productivity by seamlessly integrating AI into coding environments, aligning perfectly with Elon Musk's ambitions in artificial intelligence. This strategic deal signifies a pivotal moment in the evolution of software development towards AI-enhanced coding techniques.

title: From selling fruits to pioneering cancer care: Dr Deshmane's journey
content: Dr. Vijayalakshmi Deshmane triumphed over numerous obstacles, ranging from financial struggles to academic difficulties, to emerge as a leading surgical oncologist. She launched her medical journey supported by her mother's sacrifices and her sister's motivation. Notably, she broke barriers as her institution's first female MS in General Surgery graduate. Her unwavering dedication to breast cancer research and better treatment access culminated in being awarded the esteemed Padma Shri.

title: Google renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ in US; what others will see
content: In a bold move, President Trump has rebranded Lake Ontario as Lake America during ongoing trade conflicts. This shift is now reflected on Google Maps for American users, while international observers will encounter alternative names. Apple's mapping services have also adopted this change, prompting a response from the Canadian Prime Minister, who emphasized the historical significance of the original designation.

title: Australia lose patience as star batter left out of ODI squad
content: Australia have dropped Marnus Labuschagne from their ODI squad for tours of Zimbabwe and South Africa after a poor run of form. His Test future is also uncertain. Travis Head and Mitchell Marsh return, while Joel Davies earns his first ODI call-up. Spencer Johnson and Billy Stanlake strengthen the pace attack as Australia prepares for the 2027 World Cup.

title: Alcaraz makes winning US Open return after injury: ‘I had more nerves than usual’
content: Carlos Alcaraz returned to Grand Slam action with a straight-sets win over Roman Safiullin at the US Open, easing concerns about his wrist injury. The Spaniard said he felt completely pain-free and wants to enjoy the tournament. Defending champion Aryna Sabalenka also won her opener, while Novak Djokovic’s early exit and Jannik Sinner’s injury boost Alcaraz’s title chances.

title: Badshah and Isha Rikhi announce divorce 5 months after marriage
content: Rapper Badshah and actress Isha Rikhi have officially announced their separation after weeks of swirling rumors. They revealed the news via similar statements on their Instagram Stories. This marks the end of Badshah's second marriage; he has a daughter from his first. The couple urged for privacy and requested a halt to any further speculation about their lives.

title: It's time to move from endless war to end of war: PM Modi to Putin
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged President Vladimir Putin to end the ongoing conflict. He emphasized that humanity's well-being depends on moving from endless war to peace. India supports all efforts to resolve issues peacefully and swiftly. Discussions also covered expanding cooperation in various key sectors. Both leaders agreed to maintain contact to strengthen their partnership.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes donate $1.5 million to Kansas City charities
content: Over $1.5 million was generously granted to Kansas City charities by the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation and its allies. The foundation’s sixth annual gala attracted a crowd of over 900 supporters. In the year 2025 alone, youth volunteers accumulated over 92,000 service hours, resulting in more than $3.2 million in positive community impact. Patrick Mahomes’ charitable platform motivates these young changemakers to give back.

title: Oil climbs past $90 as Middle East conflict keeps Strait of Hormuz shut
content: On Tuesday, oil prices saw a significant uptick, driven by escalating tensions between the US and Iran and looming risks to supply chains. Brent crude hit $91.04, while WTI crude climbed to $86.55 per barrel. The Strait of Hormuz is a focal point of concern for global oil supply stability. Additionally, there are efforts in Venezuela aimed at replenishing US oil reserves.

title: Travis Kelce’s multimillion dollar investment faces trouble before new season
content: Travis Kelce is gearing up for his 14th season on the field but it seems his investment in Six Flags has landed in major trouble.

title: D4vd’s private lawyers withdraw from case: Why did he switch to a public defender?
content: D4vd’s private attorneys have withdrawn from representing him in the murder case involving 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. During an August 31, 2026 hearing, the Los Angeles County Public Defender’s Office was appointed as his new legal team. Burke has pleaded not guilty, remains jailed without bail and faces multiple charges. After a July preliminary hearing found enough evidence for trial, his next court appearance is expected in October 2026.

title: Caitlin Clark vs Sophie Cunningham net worth 2026: Who is richer?
content: Caitlin Clark's net worth is projected at 20 million dollars by 2026. Sophie Cunningham's estimated net worth stands at 3 million dollars in the same year. Clark's substantial earnings stem from extensive endorsement deals and commercial opportunities. Cunningham has built her wealth through her WNBA career and other ventures. This comparison highlights the significant financial disparity between the two players.

title: Aaron Donald returns to Rams: Can he and Myles Garrett form the NFL’s best duo?
content: Aaron Donald’s comeback to the Los Angeles Rams for the 2026 season marks a thrilling return from retirement. Joining forces with the talented edge Myles Garrett, they form an intimidating pass rush that will test the mettle of any quarterback. With aspirations of clinching a Super Bowl title in their home stadium, this partnership heralds a fresh wave of defensive excellence for the Rams, reviving hopes for passionate fans.

title: September 2026 monthly horoscope: Signs see openings and cautions
content: September brings transformative astrological insights as celestial movements play a key role for all zodiac signs. With Venus gracing Libra starting September 2, relationships and social interactions take center stage. Meanwhile, the exaltation of Mercury in Virgo from September 7 fosters enhanced decision-making and workplace productivity. As the month unfolds, focus shifts to health, daily routines, and fulfilling obligations, presenting numerous avenues for personal and career advancement.

title: Haldwani ‘purification’ row: Day after FIR against Rahul, BJP, Cong trade barbs
content: The Congress party slammed the FIR against Rahul Gandhi, calling it casteist.  BJP countered that Rahul raised the issue belatedly after a threat from Kharge.  An FIR was registered against Rahul Gandhi under various sections and the SC/ST Act.  The complainant alleged Rahul gave a caste angle to cleaning work at the rally.  Uttarakhand CM stated state residents are unaware of Kharge's caste.

title: IMD predicts below-normal rainfall over India in September
content: September rainfall across India is predicted to be below normal, concluding the monsoon season deficiently. August was the warmest on record, with several regions experiencing record high temperatures. Cumulative rainfall from June to August shows a significant deficit, impacting agricultural sowing and increasing irrigation costs. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to persist, negatively affecting monsoon rainfall patterns. Neutral Indian Ocean Dipole conditions will not benefit the monsoon this year.

title: Tupac Shakur death case: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis convicted of first-degree murder
content: Duane Davis was convicted of orchestrating Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder.  The jury reached its verdict after nearly thirty years since the shooting occurred.  Prosecutors presented multiple statements where Davis admitted responsibility for the fatal incident.  His defense argued he was lying, but no witness corroborated this claim.  Davis now faces a potential life sentence for his role in the crime.

title: Nepal tragedy: Owners missing, dog refuses to leave flood-hit Trishuli home
content: A black-and-white dog remains at the site of four homes destroyed by a flood.  He refuses to leave the muddy patch where his home once stood.  Rescue workers and JCBs clear debris around the steadfast canine.  Volunteers offer food and water, which he accepts quietly when alone.  Displaced residents understand his loyalty to his former territory.

title: Argentina president Milei joins tributes to Messi, calls him an ‘impossible man’
content: Lionel Messi’s international retirement has prompted tributes across Argentina, including an emotional message from President Javier Milei. After 207 appearances and 125 goals, Messi leaves the national team following a 21-year career featuring a World Cup and two Copa América titles. The 39-year-old will continue playing for Inter Miami, but his Argentina chapter is now over.

title: Toxic Box Office Day 6: Yash film drops 67%, crosses Rs 304 cr worldwide
content: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups saw earnings drop significantly on its first Monday. The film collected Rs 7.45 crore net in India on its sixth day. This collection brings the movie's India net total to Rs 221.55 crore. Worldwide gross earnings for the film have now reached Rs 304.05 crore. The Kannada version recorded the strongest overall occupancy among major language releases.

title: Liverpool FC exists because Everton refused to pay higher rent in 1892
content: The Merseyside derby rivalry began with a bitter rent dispute, not on the pitch. Everton left Anfield in 1892 after falling out with stadium owner John Houlding, prompting him to create Liverpool Football Club to keep the ground occupied. More than 130 years later, that landlord dispute has become the unlikely origin story of English football’s fiercest rivalries.

title: Government terms arbitration award on Indus Waters Treaty ‘illegal’
content: In a decisive move, India has dismissed an arbitration court's ruling related to the Indus Waters Treaty, asserting that the court lacks authority over sovereign matters. This echoes India's previous stance on a similar arbitration award. The Permanent Court of Arbitration urged India to respect its treaty obligations, but India firmly reaffirms that its suspension of treaty enforcement remains effective.

title: 5-member NCLT bench to hear Indiabulls plea against Chandra
content: A five-member bench is set to examine the plea from Indiabulls Housing Finance against Subhash Chandra. This review follows the NCLAT's validation of a Rs 6.5 crore payment order. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta contends that this ruling undermines the principles of the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code. The NCLT delivered a divided opinion regarding Chandra's repayment strategy.

title: Iran president meets PM Modi, seeks help to end war
content: Prime Minister Modi convened with Iranian President Pezeshkian to advance discussions on fortifying trade connections between their nations. Both leaders acknowledged the critical role of maritime freedom and trade in the region. They also discussed the ongoing situations in West Asia, focusing on the importance of Chabahar port collaboration. President Pezeshkian encouraged India to mediate for peace, underscoring their shared dedication to enhancing bilateral economic cooperation.

title: Major shake-up in Pakistan cricket: Seven players, coaches Sarfaraz, Gul released
content: Following a string of losses, the Pakistan Cricket Board has made significant changes by releasing seven players and parts of the coaching staff. Five new uncapped players have been brought on board, while Sarfaraz Ahmed and Umar Gul step aside from their coaching positions. Mike Hesson and Ashley Noffke will now oversee the coaching duties as the team readies itself for the third Test match against England at Edgbaston.

title: Economy grew 7.8% in Q1 despite Iran crisis and El Nino conditions
content: India's economy recorded impressive growth of 7.8% during the April to June quarter, driven by a thriving manufacturing sector and a strong services industry. Domestic demand surged, bolstered by significant increases in investment and exports. Reflecting this positive trend, the government has upgraded growth projections for prior financial years, showcasing the economy's robust resilience in the face of global challenges.

title: Spiders' stomach contents can reveal which insects and animals are living around them
content: 'reliable prey DNA' could be found in wolf spiders after feeding . experiments showed DNA from some prey could still be detected several days after a meal . findings suggest spiders could become useful biological samplers for studying food webs and small creatures living in an area .

title: Malicious ads on social media lure users into fraud: Centre
content: the national cybercrime threat analytics unit (NCTAU) warns of financial fraud via sideloaded malicious Android apps disguised as porn apps . misleading ads under the names Night Play, Reloop, Kyss, Riva, Vima, Nexo and Vixa redirect users to phishing websites featuring pornographic content . the app requests permissions that allow it to install additional applications, enabling fraudsters to take control of the device .

title: US army secretary Driscoll steps down amid 'tensions' with Pentagon chief Hegseth
content: army secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned after 18 months in the post . he is the latest senior military official to leave the Trump administration . the move comes after months of reported friction between him and hegseth .

title: GOATbye: Leo blows whistle on Messimerising international career

title: Power failure hits Jaipur centres again, AIIMS CRE exam cancelled
content: power failures at two jaipur examination centres disrupted the AIIMS Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) 2026 a day after a similar power supply failure hit NEET-PG at the same locations . the same iON Digital Zone in Sitapura witnessed another disruption during the examination .

title: SC Collegium recommends new CJs for Rajasthan, MP, J&K and Chhattisgarh
